cases.note: The verifier does not refuse sender == server: BRC-42 with the counterparty set to one's own key is well defined, the output pays a key the server can spend, so it is a real payment. Refusing self-payment is a policy above the verifier.

cases.description: The BEEF carries the subject and the parent it spends, no BUMP for either: no merkle path, no proven ancestry, so the proofs give no root.
cases.name: spv-no-root
cases.note: The payer's side (the captain's recommendation of 2026-10-09, docs/lanes/brc29-noroot-class.md, ruled by the owner rules): nothing the server could retry, so the 4xx class and no fields; the payer must send a proven BEEF. Nothing is asked of the header service. The parent pays the sender's own key the price and spends the synthetic prevout of the producer's cases; neither transaction carries a BUMP. Produced here by tools/brc29_noroot_cases.py from the exact-amount keys, not by the Cloudflare crate's build_vectors (crate_result null); parent txid 6b68ea8de3b8c80cc9bb3f2b867d3e46c51830b8f65259419f777fce62a45e1a.

cases.description: The BEEF carries the subject alone, no BUMP; its one input spends a transaction the BEEF does not carry.
cases.name: spv-incomplete-beef
cases.note: The payer's side, as spv-no-root: the 4xx class and no fields; nothing is asked of the header service. The subject is spv-no-root's (same bytes, same txid); its parent is not carried, so the BEEF cannot be walked to a proof. Produced here by tools/brc29_noroot_cases.py (crate_result null).

derivation.sender_side: child public key for (sender_private_key, counterparty = server_identity_key, for_self = false); equal by BRC-42
derivation.server_side: child public key for (server_private_key, counterparty = sender_identity_key, for_self = true)

description: BRC-29 payment verification before internalize: does output `output_index` of the payment transaction pay the server's BRC-29 derived key at least `required_satoshis`, and does its merkle proof tie to a block header? See conformance/README.md.
producer: bsv-middleware-cloudflare 0.3.6 tests/conformance_brc29.rs build_vectors (fixed synthetic inputs; regenerate, never retype)

words.NoHeaderService: Refuse before any other check: no usable header service is configured (fail-closed misconfiguration).
words.RootMismatch: Refuse: the header at the proof's height carries a different merkle root (fail-closed fraud signal). fields.height, fields.merkle_root (the proof's root).
words.Underpaid: Refuse: the output pays the derived key less than required. fields.paid, fields.required.
words.Unverifiable: Refuse: a merkle root could not be checked (fail-closed): the header service errored at fields.height (the first such height in height order), or the BEEF carries no proof at all (no fields).
words.WrongScript: Refuse: the output's locking script is not the expected one. fields.expected_script, fields.actual_script.

rulings.why: fail closed on a header lookup error (the agents side's epoch Rule 27; the north star's second and fifth tests); the Cloudflare crate fails closed in 0.3.9

rulings.why: the class of a payment whose proofs give no root: Unverifiable keeps its word and its reason splits the class; a lookup error is the server's side (5xx, retry; the ruling of 2026-10-08), no root is the payer's (4xx, no fields, send a proven BEEF); the captain's call of 2026-10-09, docs/lanes/brc29-noroot-class.md, ruled by the owner on 2026-10-09)
